title: processes component diagram
description: The repository's parts: the project-management conventions, the skills and knowledge catalogue its .dev folders follow, and the repository those are copied from, which in turn links back to the deployable documentation.

sources.symbol: Where the twelve deployable documents went

components.name: processes
components.responsibility: Conventions, templates and tools for software development processes that are not tied to any one system.

components.name: Project management (project-management)
components.responsibility: Conventions for running a project; today the twelve documents every deployable carries, as templates to copy.

components.name: Skills and knowledge catalogue (Meta/Agents)
components.responsibility: How .dev files are written, and the two validators that check every .dev file in the repository; a copy, changed only where it comes from.

components.name: human-assisted-software-development
components.responsibility: Another repository: the source of the skills and the knowledge catalogue, whose catalogue adapts the twelve deployable documents into knowledge kinds.

relationships.description: Copied unchanged from its Agents/Skills and Agents/Knowledge; changed there and copied here.
Its knowledge catalogue links to project-management/deployable-documentation and maps each of the twelve documents to the kinds adapted from it.
